scope: Read-only source review; no physical unload or native motor call was executed.
finding: Engineered motor hold policy lacks whole-consist physical body availability checks.
observations: EngineeredInterlock checks logical stopping/maintenance/restraints/fault/PAX flags after consist resolution.
VehicleOperations.consist resolves selected chassis and logical peer variants but does not require every peer chassis and carrier body to exist.
RideTelemetry.sample separately denies availability when any chassis/carrier is absent.
VehicleLifecycle handles permanent REMOVED bodies by rider recovery, which opens restraints and therefore holds motors; other removal reasons return without changing logical ride flags.
CarrierRuntime skips absent child bodies without directly establishing a matching interlock in this path.
Existing direct MotorDrive.apply regression tests missing logical peer data, not physical peer chassis/carrier unavailability.
source_derived_counterexample: A non-PAX running consist with closed restraints, no fault/maintenance/stopping flags, logical records intact and one missing carrier passes the Engineered flag predicate even though telemetry reports unavailable. Whether a particular native unloading sequence reaches this state requires runtime evidence.
requested_validation: Directly invoke native MotorDrive.apply before subsequent controller/physics repair ticks while selected-car or trailing-car carrier body is unavailable; assert zero propulsion impulse.
Exercise a physically unavailable linked chassis with its logical record intact.
Restore availability and prove permitted healthy operation is not permanently blocked.
Keep ordinary recovery-cart and PAX ownership policies unchanged; assess target-host performance if adding per-callback scans.
